"""Complete district episode via gamepad actions on the real HTTP/WebGL game.
No position, currency, health, enemy or mission-state writes. Read-only snapshots.
"""
import json,math,os,time
from pathlib import Path
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2];OUT=ROOT/'aether-reach/test-output';OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
BASE=os.getenv('TEST_BASE_URL','http://127.0.0.1:4173');checks=[];errors=[];native=[]
def check(ok,text):
 assert ok,text
 checks.append(text);print('PASS',text,flush=True)
with sync_playwright() as pw:
 b=pw.chromium.launch(headless=True,args=['--no-sandbox','--use-gl=angle','--use-angle=swiftshader','--enable-unsafe-swiftshader'])
 c=b.new_context(viewport={'width':960,'height':640},device_scale_factor=.5,service_workers='block')
 c.add_init_script(path=str(ROOT/'aether-reach/tests/fake-devices.js'))
 c.add_init_script("if(!localStorage.getItem('aether-reach.visual.v1'))localStorage.setItem('aether-reach.visual.v1',JSON.stringify({mode:'low'}))")
 p=c.new_page();p.set_default_timeout(90000);p.on('pageerror',lambda e:errors.append(str(e)))
 def dialog(d):native.append(d.type);d.dismiss()
 p.on('dialog',dialog)
 def snap():return p.evaluate('AetherReach.snapshot()')
 def frames(n=3):p.evaluate('(n)=>new Promise(resolve=>{function f(){if(--n<=0)resolve();else requestAnimationFrame(f);}requestAnimationFrame(f)})',n)
 def tap(i):p.evaluate('(i)=>new Promise(resolve=>{TestPad.button(i,true);requestAnimationFrame(()=>{TestPad.button(i,false);requestAnimationFrame(resolve);});})',i)
 def held(i,on):p.evaluate('([i,on])=>TestPad.button(i,on)',[i,on]);frames(2)
 def axes(a):p.evaluate('(a)=>TestPad.axes(a)',a)
 def stage():return sum(f in snap()['expedition']['flags'] for f in ['afterlight-started','afterlight-fuse','afterlight-circuit','afterlight-beacon','afterlight-complete'])
 def go(sel):
  for _ in range(100):
   a=p.evaluate('''sel=>{const r=document.getElementById(AetherReach.snapshot().devices.menu),a=[...r.querySelectorAll('button,input:not([type="hidden"]),select,a[href]')].filter(e=>!e.disabled&&!e.hidden&&!e.closest('[hidden]')&&e.getClientRects().length);return[a.indexOf(document.activeElement),a.indexOf(r.querySelector(sel))]}''',sel)
   assert a[1]>=0,'Unavailable control '+sel
   if a[0]==a[1]:return
   tap(13 if a[0]<a[1] else 12)
  raise AssertionError('Cannot reach '+sel)
 def choose(sel):go(sel);tap(0)
 def drive(x,z):
  start=time.monotonic()
  while time.monotonic()-start<140:
   s=snap();assert not s['paused'],'Unexpected paused state';q=s['position'];dx=x-q['x'];dz=z-q['z'];d=math.hypot(dx,dz)
   if d<.38:axes([0,0,0,0]);frames();return
   delta=math.atan2(math.sin(math.atan2(dx,-dz)-q['yaw']),math.cos(math.atan2(dx,-dz)-q['yaw']))
   turn=0 if abs(delta)<.035 else math.copysign(.18+.82*min(1,abs(delta)*.9)**(1/1.35),delta)
   axes([0,-min(1,d) if abs(delta)<.19 else 0,turn,0]);frames(2)
  raise AssertionError('Blocked route '+str((x,z))+' at '+str(snap()['position']))
 def look(yaw,pitch):
  start=time.monotonic()
  while time.monotonic()-start<80:
   q=snap()['position'];dy=math.atan2(math.sin(yaw-q['yaw']),math.cos(yaw-q['yaw']));dp=pitch-q['pitch']
   if abs(dy)<.009 and abs(dp)<.009:axes([0,0,0,0]);frames();return
   def axis(v):return 0 if abs(v)<.006 else math.copysign(.18+.82*min(1,abs(v)*1.6)**(1/1.35),v)
   axes([0,0,axis(dy),-axis(dp)]);frames(2)
  raise AssertionError('Aim did not settle')
 def fight(prefix=None,limit=120):
  start=time.monotonic();ignored=set()
  while time.monotonic()-start<limit:
   s=snap();q=s['position'];targets=[e for e in s['enemies'] if e['hp']>0 and e['kind']!='target' and e['id'] not in ignored and (not prefix or e['id'].startswith(prefix)) and math.hypot(e['x']-q['x'],e['z']-q['z'])<36]
   if not targets:return
   t=min(targets,key=lambda t:math.hypot(t['x']-q['x'],t['z']-q['z']))
   look(math.atan2(t['x']-q['x'],-(t['z']-q['z'])),math.atan2(t['y']+.38-(q['y']+1.65),math.hypot(t['x']-q['x'],t['z']-q['z'])))
   if snap()['ammo']==0:
    held(2,True);p.wait_for_timeout(650);frames(8);held(2,False);p.wait_for_function('AetherReach.snapshot().reload===0');frames(3)
   held(6,True);held(7,True);frames(26);held(7,False);held(6,False)
   now=next((e for e in snap()['enemies'] if e['id']==t['id']),None)
   if now and now['hp']==t['hp']:ignored.add(t['id'])
  raise AssertionError('Combat input budget exceeded')
 def use(id):
  check(snap()['interactionId']==id,'World interaction reachable: '+id);tap(2);frames(3)
 try:
  p.goto(BASE+'/aether-reach/index.html',wait_until='domcontentloaded');p.wait_for_function('!!window.AetherReach')
  check(p.evaluate('AetherReach.version')=='0.9.0','Version 0.9.0 boots the actual episode')
  p.evaluate('TestPad.connect()');frames();tap(0);check(snap()['playing'],'A starts from title without mouse capture')
  drive(3,7);tap(15);choose('[data-buy="carbine"][data-kind="weapon"]');tap(1)
  # Travel on the already-published railway, not a test teleport.
  drive(-9,0);tap(2);p.wait_for_function('AetherReach.snapshot().rail?.id==="bellline"');p.wait_for_function('!AetherReach.snapshot().rail',timeout=90000);frames(10)
  drive(-84,-4);use('afterlight-board');check(stage()==1,'Dispatch accepted and Bellwether checkpoint earned');tap(12);frames();check(snap()['renderer']['afterlight']['routeMarkers']>0,'D-pad up projects actual route arrows on the market floor')
  fight(limit=120);drive(-75,-20);use('afterlight-fuse');fight('afterlight-street',limit=140);frames(5);use('afterlight-fuse');check(stage()==2,'Two actual street guards cleared and fuse collected')
  # Reload only a save earned through these actions. This is the restore test.
  p.reload(wait_until='domcontentloaded');p.wait_for_function('!!window.AetherReach');p.evaluate('TestPad.connect()');frames();choose('#continue');check(stage()==2 and 'carbine' in snap()['carried'],'Continue preserves the fuse, carried equipment and district checkpoint')
  for x,z in [(-96,-20),(-103,-21.5),(-103,-26)]:drive(x,z)
  fight(limit=100);drive(-107,-26);use('afterlight-clue');p.wait_for_selector('#afterlight-dialog[open]');p.screenshot(path=str(OUT/'afterlight-workshop-clue.png'));tap(1);check(not snap()['paused'],'B dismisses the clue and resumes gameplay')
  for i,(x,turns) in enumerate([(-107,3),(-103,1),(-99,2)]):
   drive(x,-33)
   for _ in range(turns):use('afterlight-dial-'+str(i))
  drive(-98,-26);use('afterlight-test');check(stage()==3,'Physical workshop relay puzzle completed')
  tap(12);check('Theatre' in p.locator('#crosswind-nav').inner_text(),'Objective hint advances to the Theatre ladder after the workshop')
  for x,z in [(-103,-26),(-103,-21),(-97,-20),(-97,0),(-107,.1)]:drive(x,z)
  tap(2);p.wait_for_function('!!AetherReach.snapshot().climb');axes([0,-1,0,0]);p.wait_for_function('!AetherReach.snapshot().climb&&AetherReach.snapshot().grounded',timeout=90000);axes([0,0,0,0]);frames()
  check(abs(snap()['position']['y']-27.5)<.05,'Theatre rooftop reached by continuous controller climbing')
  drive(-110,-5);use('afterlight-beacon');fight('afterlight-roof',limit=140)
  p.wait_for_function('AetherReach.snapshot().expedition.flags.includes("afterlight-beacon")',timeout=90000)
  check(stage()==4,'Rooftop defense requires actual defeated guards and elapsed broadcast time')
  p.screenshot(path=str(OUT/'afterlight-theatre-broadcast.png'))
  drive(-107,-2.1);tap(2);p.wait_for_function('!!AetherReach.snapshot().climb');axes([0,1,0,0]);p.wait_for_function('!AetherReach.snapshot().climb&&AetherReach.snapshot().grounded',timeout=90000);axes([0,0,0,0]);frames()
  drive(-97,0);drive(-84,-4);before=snap()['credits'];use('afterlight-board');check(stage()==5 and snap()['credits']==before+240,'Return to dispatch earns exactly 240 completion credits')
  p.wait_for_selector('#afterlight-dialog[open]');p.screenshot(path=str(OUT/'afterlight-ending.png'));tap(1);use('afterlight-board');check(snap()['credits']==before+240,'Repeated completion interaction cannot duplicate the reward')
  check(snap()['stats']['rescues']==0,'Carried-state rooftop and return route needs no safety rescue')
  check(not errors and not native,'No uncaught errors or native alert/confirm interruptions')
  (OUT/'afterlight-browser.json').write_text(json.dumps({'passed':len(checks),'checks':checks,'errors':errors,'nativeDialogs':native,'state':snap(),'scope':'Real HTTP Chromium WebGL with emulated standard Gamepad API; ordinary inputs and one reload of the actually earned save. Light graphics at half pixel density. Not physical Xbox/Quest, subjective listening or performance certification.'},indent=2))
 except Exception as e:
  try:s=snap()
  except:s=None
  (OUT/'afterlight-failure.json').write_text(json.dumps({'error':str(e),'checks':checks,'errors':errors,'state':s},indent=2))
  try:p.screenshot(path=str(OUT/'afterlight-failure.png'))
  except:pass
  raise
 finally:c.close();b.close()
